chunks.title: FastAPI Uvicorn Minimal Dockerfile
chunks.content:
FastAPI Uvicorn Minimal Dockerfile

Minimal Dockerfile for a FastAPI backend started with uvicorn. Base image: python:3.11-slim. WORKDIR /app. Copies requirements.txt first, runs pip install --no-cache-dir, then copies full source. Sets PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1, exposes port 8000. CMD: sh -c uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000.

Decision rules:
- Use when project_type=api_backend, framework=fastapi, runtime=pip
- Use python:3.11-slim to keep image size minimal
- Set PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 so log output is streamed immediately to stdout

Trade-offs:
- No multi-stage build — image includes pip and build tools, larger than distroless variants
- No non-root USER defined — extend with USER directive for production hardening

Anti-patterns:
- Do not hardcode secrets in ENV or ARG instructions inside the Dockerfile
- Do not COPY . . before COPY requirements.txt — breaks Docker layer caching
